onboarding.done_body: The daily challenge is the same for everyone. Compare with friends.
onboarding.s2_body: Look at the photo, enter a price, score points for how close you are.
onboarding.s3_daily: Daily challenge: 5 rounds, the same for everyone.
onboarding.s3_duel: Duels and rooms: challenge friends in real time.
onboarding.s4_body: Optional: link Apple or Google so results and friends are kept. Works without an account too.

daily.info_body: Each round gives 0–1000 points based on how close you are to the asking price. The error is relative: 10% off scores the same at €40,000 and at €400,000.
daily.info_grid: 🟩 within 10% · 🟨 within 25% · 🟥 beyond. Colour follows the error, not the points.
daily.info_reset: A new challenge every day at 00:00 Riga time. One attempt.

leaderboard.username_banner: Pick a username to appear on the board

auth.save_progress_body: Link an account so your results, streaks and friends survive a new phone.
auth.linked_body: Your account is linked. You can sign in from any device.
auth.restored_body: Your previous results and friends are back.
auth.merged_from_linked_body: Your progress is now on this {{provider}} account. The previous {{oldProviders}} link is gone — sign in with {{provider}} from now on.
auth.switched_body: You are now signed in as {{username}}. Your previous account {{oldUsername}} is still available via {{oldProviders}}.
auth.switched_body_lost: You are now signed in as {{username}}. Your previous account {{oldUsername}} was only on this device and is no longer available.
auth.account_not_linked: This account lives only on this device. Link Apple or Google so nothing gets lost.
auth.sign_out_body: A new empty account will be created on this device. Sign in again with Apple or Google to come back.

err.merge_expired: The link request expired. Try again.
err.provider_unavailable: This sign-in is not available here.
err.unknown: Could not link the account. Try again.

profile.delete_body: All results, friends and duels will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
profile.delete_body2: Last warning: the account and its data will be deleted permanently.
